subject: humanities
notes: Between 1885 and 1916 the workshop of jeweler Peter Carl Fabergé in St. Petersburg, Russia, made fifty jeweled eggs for the Russian imperial family.
The first egg, given by Emperor Alexander III to his wife in 1885, had a plain white enamel shell.
It opened to reveal a gold yolk, and inside the yolk sat a tiny golden hen.
Every later egg was also designed to open and reveal a hidden surprise.
The egg of 1900 contained a miniature working model of a Trans-Siberian Railway train.
Forty-three of the fifty eggs are known to survive today.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a design feature shared by all of the imperial eggs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Of the fifty imperial eggs made by Fabergé's workshop, forty-three are known to survive today.
choices.B: Between 1885 and 1916 the workshop of Peter Carl Fabergé in St. Petersburg made fifty jeweled eggs for the Russian imperial family.
choices.C: The first imperial egg, given by Alexander III to his wife in 1885, had a plain white shell that opened to reveal a gold yolk and a tiny golden hen.
choices.D: Every imperial egg was designed to open and reveal a hidden surprise, such as the golden hen inside the first egg of 1885 or the miniature train inside the egg of 1900.

explanation.why: The goal asks for a feature shared by all the eggs, so the sentence must make a general statement, not describe one egg. The notes say every egg opened to reveal a surprise. The correct choice states that rule and illustrates it; choice C describes only the first egg, which is an example rather than the shared feature.
explanation.A: Incorrect. How many eggs survive has nothing to do with their design.
explanation.B: Incorrect. It gives the maker, dates, and number of eggs but no design feature.
explanation.C: Incorrect. It describes the surprise in one egg only, so it does not say the feature was shared by all of them. This is the closest near miss.
explanation.D: Correct. "Every imperial egg" states the shared feature, and the two examples show it.
